STRAIGHTFORWARD PACKAGES

Choose the Right Service

Three clear options based on what your grout, tile and caulking need.

PACKAGE 01

Clean, Seal & Caulk

A refresh for tile and grout, including failing caulk where needed.

  • Heavy-duty degreaser and bristle brushes
  • Hands-on scrubbing of grout joints
  • Air mover to help dry the area
  • Remove and replace failing caulk
  • Water-based sealer where suitable
Ask About Package 1 →
PACKAGE 02

Clean, Seal, Re-caulk & Pan Re-grout

The cleaning refresh plus renewed grout in the shower pan where appropriate.

  • Cleaning and preparation
  • Replace failing caulk as needed
  • Regrout the shower pan
  • Discuss suitable grout options
Ask About Package 2 →
PACKAGE 03

Full Re-grout

For larger tiled areas where grout needs more extensive renewal.

  • Review existing grout and tile
  • Prepare joints as appropriate
  • Install grout suited to the project
  • Ask about high-grade epoxy grout
Ask About Package 3 →
